name: claude-startup-finance
description: Unofficial Claude connectors and finance workflows for the startup back-office stack. Start with finance-contextos to build your ContextOS, add all-systems-go for the rest of your stack. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Stripe, Ramp, Mercury, Intuit, or Anthropic.

plugins.name: finance-contextos
plugins.description: Start here. Build your company's ContextOS — the finance context Claude loads before touching your numbers. One QuickBooks connector (read-only, your own login), a guided account-map + finance-profile build with human review gates, and a tie-out that proves the result against your live books.

plugins.name: all-systems-go
plugins.description: The enrichment pack for your ContextOS, named for airCFO's All Systems Go series on the startup back-office stack. Adds Stripe, Ramp, and Mercury connectors plus cross-system workflows (runway & burn, revenue reconciliation, board metrics) and meta-skills to author your own. Install finance-contextos first.
